name: App Volume Mixer
description:
Per-app volume control in Quick Settings.

Click the arrow next to the volume slider and every app that's playing audio gets its own slider and mute button:

* Turn one app down without touching the others
* Click an app's icon to mute or unmute it
* Apps with several streams (browser tabs, games) get one row
* Stays in sync with changes made in the app itself, pavucontrol or Settings

Works with PipeWire and PulseAudio.
